_comment: Daily Google-search dump for serp-check.mjs. Run a plain Google search (google.com.sg) for each keyword in serp-keywords.json, then list the organic result URLs top-to-bottom (about 10). Then: node seo/serp-check.mjs --ingest=seo/serp-ingest.json  — you don't have to include every keyword; missing ones are skipped.
